verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, not a software service with an API, so asking for a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. The probe of intel.com OpenAPI paths concerns the vendor's website, not the CPU, and nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
